front.label: Front
front.desc: Your name, your number out of 25 and the two brands, set inside a Hyperliquid shape written in the HYPE genesis record.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name, etched and filled in Hyperliquid mint.

front.label: Brands
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the official wordmarks in white.

front.label: Genesis fill
front.desc: The Hyperliquid shape is written in the HYPE genesis record. HYPERLIQUID, INDIA and ENS are always whole words.

front.label: Hyperliquid line
front.desc: Hyperliquid terms in dimmed mint beside the name: HyperCore, HyperEVM, HyperBFT, HIP-3, HIP-4.

back.label: Back
back.desc: Nothing loud. Empty metal, a tracking reticle, and the place the card was made.

back.label: The fix
back.desc: House of HYPE, Mumbai, in coordinates and a date. Where and when this card entered the world.

back.label: Reticle
back.desc: A tracking reticle holding the QR. Tap the card or scan it to verify the holder onchain.

back.label: Namehash rail
back.desc: Your name's onchain ID runs along the bottom edge in micro mint. The only thing on this side that is yours alone.

back.label: Brands
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS. The only element shared with the front.
